rules.statement: A vendor can be held liable for breaches of covenants even if the vendee knew about potential defects, as long as the covenants are clear and express.
rules.supporting_quote: "The defendant followed this up by covenanting that he would warrant and defend title against all disputes and objections. These are express covenants, and therefore even knowledge of defects on tie part of Adam Bawa will not affect the liability of the defendant."
